data.title: Rect select with copy/paste (floating paste, both modes)

data.body:
Implementation complete (4 commits: 168b0c3 marquee, 1a0d77d copy/cut/delete, 909582e float, 43b1066 polish). npx tsc --noEmit + npm run build green after every step; git tree clean.

WHAT LANDED — per the plan: new src/state/selection.ts (DOM-free: SelRect/Float/SelectionState, copyRect/eraseRect/stampFloat via getViewPx/plotView, clampFloatPos), new src/tools/select.ts (passive + clampToWindow, marquee + float drag + click-outside-commits), dirtySel in the store, opt-in Tool flags + 5 ToolContext selection methods, grid-editor (sel dep, toPt window clamp, bumpForTool routing, clearRect-then-drawImage float compositing, ants), chrome.drawMarquee (static two-tone 1-device-px hairline), main.ts (clipboard + 8 actions + keyboard precedence + stamp-on-context-change), toolbar icon, LCD sel segment. doc.ts/history.ts/persist.ts/raster/preview/export/other tools/app.css untouched, as specified. No new deps.

SMOKE (throwaway node harness over the compiled pure module, not committed): 22/22 assertions pass — border multi-cell copy returns transparent for locked-centre pixels; erase writes 0 (transparency, not paper) and is bounded; stamp is verbatim (transparent float pixels punch holes); cut→stamp round-trips the sheet byte-for-byte; stamp clips the locked centre and off-sheet; tile copy across a cell seam reads the wrapped content; tile stamp wraps (incl. view coords beyond the tile, and wider-than-C last-write-wins); clampFloatPos (inside/pinned/focused-window/oversized-pins-to-origin); rectFromPoints; cropTopLeft.

ACCEPTANCE (code-verified = harness or provable by construction; browser = needs a real pointer/paint):
1 marquee/click-deselect/LCD — browser (registry, hotkey m, icon, LCD segment code-verified).
2 border multi-cell copy, locked centre transparent — CODE-VERIFIED.
3 cut leaves transparency, one undo step, selection survives — CODE-VERIFIED (erase→0; exactly one history.push per action); keystroke path browser.
4 paste floats/drag/nudge/never leaves the window — clampFloatPos CODE-VERIFIED; rest browser.
5 stamp one undo entry + re-selects stamped bounds — CODE-VERIFIED by construction; browser.
6 cancel keeps the doc + clipboard; undo while floating drops the float — code-read; browser.
7 tile torus copy/stamp wrap — CODE-VERIFIED; 'no preview/autosave churn during drags' CODE-VERIFIED by construction (passive tools bump dirtySel only; the debouncer and autosave subscribe to dirtyDoc/dirtyPreview) — observe in browser.
8 border clipping on stamp — CODE-VERIFIED.
9 Esc precedence float→rect→focus, never swallowed idle — code-read; browser.
10 focus interplay (window clamp, centred paste, exit-on-doesn't-fit, stamp on enter/exit/mode/tool/cell) — code-read; browser.
11 no regressions — typecheck+build green, passive/clampToWindow are opt-in and every non-select pointer path is byte-identical; browser sweep of the seven tools still needed.
12 brand audit — CODE-VERIFIED for substance (only #FF4E00/#FBFAF8 in the ants, no CSS changes, lowercase deadpan copy, nothing animates); visual check browser.

DEVIATIONS (all small, all deliberate):
a. selection.ts exports two helpers beyond the plan's list: rectFromPoints (marquee normalization — keeps the math in the pure module) and cropTopLeft (the plan's 'clip the pasted buffer to LxL' rule needed a crop and raster/buffer.ts is off-limits).
b. moveFocus now clears the marked rect. The plan said 'no change needed', but that line is about floats; moveFocus changes the window exactly like enter/exitFocus, and a rect left behind in another cell would be invisible yet still live for copy/cut.
c. Ants clip is the art rect inflated by 1 device px (the width the ants sit outside the marked pixels) so an edge-to-edge marquee still shows its hairline instead of being clipped to nothing. A rect outside the window still cannot paint the letterbox.
d. Pasting while a float is live stamps the existing float first (plan didn't specify; consistent with stamp-on-context-change).
e. Delete/Backspace calls preventDefault when it acts (stops browser back-navigation).
f. drawMarquee(ctx,x,y,w,h,z) takes window-local LOGICAL coords + zoom; the plan's prose showed pre-multiplied device px in the call site while the signature carried z. Same geometry either way.

KNOWN GAP for the reviewer to rule on (out of the plan's scope, not fixed): png/css export, save and autosave do not stamp a live float — the float is not part of the document until stamped (it never bumps dirtyDoc), which is coherent but means exporting mid-paste omits what is on screen.

REVIEW (fresh context, did not write this code). Read the plan, then 168b0c3 / 1a0d77d / 909582e / 43b1066 cold, plus the full current text of every touched file and the pre-existing files they lean on (doc.ts, buffer.ts, history.ts, toolbar.ts). Verdict: PASS with one trivial fix applied inline (6b119c3). No implementation-level or plan-level rework needed.

MECHANICAL: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npm run build` clean (35.4 kB / 12.8 kB gz); `npm run dev` serves 200 and /src/main.ts transforms. No lint script in package.json. Working tree clean.

INDEPENDENT HARNESS (mine, not the implementer's; scratchpad only, not committed): 105 assertions over src/state/selection.ts bundled straight from source with esbuild — 105 passed, 0 failed. Covers rectFromPoints in all four drag directions + degenerate; border multi-cell copy across the locked centre (per-pixel, 64 assertions: every centre pixel transparent, every live pixel copied); copy off the sheet edge; erase writes 0 and is bounded and is a no-op off-sheet; cut→stamp round-trips the sheet byte-for-byte; stamp verbatim (transparent float pixels punch holes); stamp clips the locked centre and the sheet edge and does not wrap in border mode; tile copy across a seam equals what getViewPx shows and reads the wrapped tile; tile stamp wraps; tile stamp wider than C is last-write-wins with the exact predicted winner per tile pixel; clampFloatPos inside/low/high/focused-window/oversized-pins-to-origin/per-axis; cropTopLeft dims, content, identity-returns-same-ref; and the paste-centring arithmetic lifted out of pasteClip (even/odd/focused/oversized).

PLAN CONSTRAINTS, ALL VERIFIED:
- dirtySel routing: previews subscribe to dirtyPreview/mode/dirtyDoc, autosave to dirtyDoc/dirtyPreview/mode/colorHex. dirtySel appears in neither — only in the grid-editor's invalidation subscription (render, no relayout). Passive tools reach bumpSel via bumpForTool; setSelection/moveFloatTo bump dirtySel directly. No marquee-drag or float-move path can touch toDataURL or localStorage.
- setCell stamps BEFORE history.pushBoth + setCellSize. Correct order, correct comment.
- Float compositing is clearRect-then-drawImage on offNative, so the checker shows through transparent float pixels — the preview is honest about what stamping will do.
- Esc precedence is float -> rect -> focus, and Esc is never preventDefault'd, so it is never swallowed when idle.
- Opt-in flags: the shared pointer pipeline gained exactly two branches (a `clampToWindow` clause in toPt placed after the unfocused early-return and before the border/tile focused branches, and bumpForTool). With both flags undefined every one of the seven pre-existing tools takes the byte-identical path — I diffed grid-editor against 6595d63 line by line to confirm nothing else in pointerdown/move/up/finish changed. Alt-pick, pointer capture, hover/displayPt, DPR watch, ResizeObserver untouched.
- File scope: the diff touches exactly the ten files in the plan's §8 table. doc.ts, history.ts, persist.ts, raster/*, preview/*, export/*, the other tools and app.css are untouched.
- Ants use #FF4E00 and #FBFAF8 only — identical to --orange and --paper in tokens.css. Nothing animates. No CSS changes.
- PM-6 cell-size input: the global keydown handler's INPUT guard fires first, so typing digits, Delete, Backspace, arrows and Enter inside the readout input cannot reach copy/cut/paste/nudge/delete. The input's own Escape handler stopPropagation()s. Verified — no conflict.

DEVIATIONS (a)-(f) from the implementation comment: all reviewed, all accepted. (b) moveFocus clearing the marked rect is right — it changes the window exactly like enter/exitFocus. (c) the inflated ants clip is right and still cannot paint the letterbox (the inflation is 1 device px, the ants' own width). (d) paste-stamps-the-previous-float is consistent with stamp-on-context-change. (e)/(f) fine.

FIX APPLIED INLINE — 6b119c3, src/main.ts, pasteClip:
pasteClip set `tip: "back to nine. it didn't fit"` and then unconditionally overwrote it with `"floating. drag it. enter stamps"` in the same synchronous turn, so the tip acceptance criterion 10 names by exact string was never readable — no paint happens between the two store.set calls. Replaced with a `didntFit` flag and a single tip choice at the end. tsc + build green after.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (code = provable from source or my harness; build = tsc/vite; browser = needs a real pointer/paint):
1  select tool / marquee / click-deselect / LCD sel  — CODE (registry order, hotkey m with no collision against p e l r o f i z 1 2, ICONS.select, LCD segment, onUp click-deselect); crispness on 1x/HiDPI = BROWSER.
2  border multi-cell copy, locked centre transparent — CODE (harness, per-pixel).
3  cut leaves transparency in one undo step, selection survives; delete writes no clipboard — CODE (erase writes 0; exactly one history.push per action; cutSel never touches sel.rect; deleteSel never assigns clipboard); keystrokes = BROWSER.
4  paste floats / drag / nudge +-1 and +-8 / never leaves the window — CODE (clampFloatPos harness + both call sites: toolCtx.moveFloatTo clamps against fx0/fy0/Lf, nudgeFloat against windowBox()); BROWSER for feel.
5  stamp = one undo entry, re-selects the stamped bounds — CODE.
6  Esc drops the float without touching the doc, clipboard survives, Ctrl+Z while floating drops the float and consumes no history — CODE (cancelFloat touches neither doc nor hist; the doUndo/doRedo guards return before history.undo).
7  tile torus copy + stamp wrap, all nine sections; no preview/autosave churn during drags — CODE (harness for the torus; subscription trace for the churn; render redraws the tile 3x3 from doc.tile every frame); BROWSER to watch it.
8  border clipping on stamp — CODE (harness: locked centre stays empty, the rest lands, off-sheet clipped, no wrap).
9  Esc precedence — CODE. Note the criterion as written ("Esc #1 float, Esc #2 selection, Esc #3 focus") is unreachable by construction: §1.6 makes rect and float mutually exclusive and cancelFloat nulls both, so from a focused float it is 2 presses, not 3. The implementation follows §1.6, which is the stronger spec. Criterion text is wrong, code is right.
10 focus interplay — CODE for the window clamp, the centred paste, the exit-on-doesn't-fit, and stamp-on-context-change (setTool / setMode / setCell / enterFocus / exitFocus / moveFocus all call commitFloatFirst; applyProject and doClear call dropSelection instead — the §1.7 cancel exception, correctly the other way round); the named tip was broken and is fixed in 6b119c3; BROWSER for the rest.
11 no regressions — BUILD + CODE (opt-in flags, byte-identical non-select paths, no edits outside the ten planned files); a browser sweep of the seven tools + focus + undo/redo + save/load is still owed and is the one thing I cannot close from here.
12 brand audit — CODE for substance (token-exact colours, no new CSS, nothing animates, lowercase deadpan copy); BROWSER for the look.

NITS (none blocking, none fixed — recording them so the next agent doesn't re-derive them):
N1 undo/redo do not clear a stale sel.rect. History entries carry cellSize (PM-6), so an undo across a cell-size change can leave a rect whose coords exceed the new L. Nothing crashes — copyRect reads transparent (border) or wrapped (tile), eraseRect rejects out of bounds, the ants clip — but the marked region no longer means what it shows. Folding clearSelectionPatch() into doUndo/doRedo would close it; I left it because undo/redo are deliberately absent from the plan's §6 clearing table and that is a design call, not a defect.
N2 the Enter branch preventDefault()s globally while a float is live, so a keyboard user whose focus sits on a toolbar or transport <button> cannot activate it with Enter until the float is stamped or cancelled. Very narrow; the arrows already behave this way while focused (pre-existing).
N3 cutSel/deleteSel push a history entry even when the marked rect lies entirely inside the border's locked centre, where nothing can change — one no-op undo step.
N4 plan §4.1 says the paste tip should mention that a tile float will wrap; the tip is mode-independent. Copy only.
N5 Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X while a float is live report "nothing selected. m marks", because rect is null by the mutual-exclusion rule. Defensible, mildly surprising.
N6 passive tools bump dirtySel twice per pointer event (setSelection/moveFloatTo bump, then bumpForTool bumps again) — two store.set and two syncAll DOM passes per pointermove. No correctness impact, and no per-move buffer allocation anywhere in the drag path (I checked: moveFloatTo allocates two small object literals, nothing copies pixels).

KNOWN GAP RULED ON — export/save/css do not stamp a live float. ACCEPTABLE AS DESIGNED, but it deserves a follow-up task rather than silence. Coherent because §1.3 makes the float explicitly not part of the document (it never bumps dirtyDoc, it is never in history), and every other context change already stamps first — doSave, doExportPng and doCopyCss are the only three escapes left. The fix is one line each (commitFloatFirst() at the top). Autosave should deliberately stay as it is: firing a stamp from a debounced timer would be a silent document mutation the user never asked for. Whether an explicit export should stamp the float or ignore it is a genuine product call, which is exactly what a follow-up task is for. Not implemented here.
